title: Finite-Precision Symmetric Krylov Methods: Exact Rounding Examples, Block Paige Identities,and a Variable-Block Lanczos Model
summary: Short-recurrence Krylov methods that are equivalent in exact arithmetic often diverge in floating-point arithmetic. To illustrate this, we provide an exactly representable two-cycle for steepest descent with a recursively updated residual. A complementary convergence theorem gives a sufficient condition under which the stored residual decreases geometrically. We then show that a second positive definite family yields different outcomes for a Hestenes--Stiefel Conjugate Gradient (CG) implementation and a direct Lanczos--Galerkin approach.
